_what: P0.3 threshold register (= R15.2, specified since adoption and declared for ZERO gates until 28-Aug-2026). Every capital-gating threshold publishes the dispersion of the quantity it tests, itself expressed in standard deviations, and its realised fire rate.
_rule: R3.11, adopted by this build — BEFORE DECLARING ANY THRESHOLD, DIVIDE IT BY THE STANDARD DEVIATION OF THE THING IT TESTS.

_verdicts.NON_INFORMATIVE: fire rate 0% or 100% over >= 6 runs -> raises
_verdicts.UNMEASURED: the SD of the tested quantity has never been measured -> raises, and is NEVER rendered as DISCRIMINATING

_populate: sd_of_quantity is populated by P1 (the 104-week store) and P2 (the covariance matrix). A null here is UNMEASURED and raises — it is not a pass.

thresholds.name: PROBATION_TRAIL_PP
thresholds.quantity_tested: cumulative 12-month relative return of the direct-stock sleeve vs VUAG.L
thresholds.sd_basis: MEASURED 28-Aug-2026: SD of the cumulative 12-month relative return of the direct-stock sleeve vs VUAG.L = the annualised tracking error over 104 Friday-to-Friday GBP weeks. ⚑ CAVEAT THAT TRAVELS (R2.6): the sleeve return assumes today's names were held for two years. They were not. This is a valid TRACKING-ERROR magnitude — a VOLATILITY property — and NOT a performance measurement. ISA-0429's -22.5pp ex-MU remains the performance read.
thresholds.note: ⚑ The spec measured 35.2%/yr TE on 27-Aug, which puts -5pp at 0.14 SD and a 44% false-fire rate on ZERO true alpha — at 6, 12 AND 24 months. The window was never the lever. Seeded null here on purpose: P1 re-measures it rather than this build copying a number across (R4.4).

thresholds.name: RHO_MAX_PAIRWISE_GATE
thresholds.quantity_tested: pairwise rho between a candidate and each held sleeve name
thresholds.sd_basis: MEASURED 28-Aug-2026: cross-sectional SD of the 15 measured pairwise correlations (rho_bar 0.1931, max 0.4542 AVGO|MU, min -0.0396 ONT.L|COCO).

thresholds.name: RHO_SLEEVE_GATE
thresholds.quantity_tested: rho between a candidate and the weighted sleeve

thresholds.name: RHO_REORDER_SE_MULTIPLE
thresholds.quantity_tested: rho_sleeve gap between two candidates in the same band
thresholds.sd_basis: MEASURED 28-Aug-2026: SE(rho) = 1/sqrt(n-3) at n=104 common Fridays.
thresholds.note: ⚑ P6.3, the self-critique of the 26-Aug design: it applied 'divide by the SD' to Raj's ratchet and not to its own sequencer. A sequencer that reorders on any rho difference resolves noise.

thresholds.name: FLAG_FRACTION_OF_STARTER
thresholds.quantity_tested: held position size as a fraction of the STARTER rung
thresholds.note: REVIEW fraction — 'below this a held position is not carrying its risk share'. DELIBERATELY DISTINCT from MIN_ENTRY_FRACTION_OF_STARTER 0.80 (P4.4).

thresholds.name: MIN_ENTRY_FRACTION_OF_STARTER
thresholds.quantity_tested: proposed new position size as a fraction of the STARTER rung
thresholds.note: ENTRY floor — 'below this, do not open a position at all'. ⚑ A future session will read 0.75 and 0.80 as a duplicate and unify them, silently moving the entry floor.

thresholds.name: ER_DEPLOY_FLOOR
thresholds.quantity_tested: expected return of a candidate vs the derived anchor + friction buffer
thresholds.sd_basis: PENDING — cross-sectional SD of candidate E[r]
thresholds.note: ⚑ Excluded 0 of 13 names in August. A21's +5 conviction floor was in practice the ONLY live tightening on this gate, and D21 retires A21 — so the residual is a MEASURED recalibration of this hurdle, never a reinstated +5 on a retired score. Value is DERIVED every run (isa_policy) and is deliberately not typed here.

thresholds.name: FUND_GATE_PCT
thresholds.quantity_tested: forward E[r] of a fund vs the anchor less the stock-sleeve margin
thresholds.note: The fund sleeve this build routes GBP 10,702 to was measured at 6.24% forward E[r] against a required 13.8-13.9%. Registered so that number is a published t-ratio rather than a fact somebody has to remember.

thresholds.name: SLEEVE_SECTOR_CAP_ISA
thresholds.quantity_tested: ISA weight of one GICS sector inside the direct-stock sleeve
thresholds.note: ⚑ HAS NEVER FIRED. `action_stack_ctx.json` does not exist and no module writes it, so `_apply_diversification` runs with an empty sector map and no cap can bind. fire_rate_history is empty because there has never been a fire to record — which is exactly what NON_INFORMATIVE is for.

thresholds.name: DIVERSIFY_OVERRIDE_DELTA
thresholds.quantity_tested: source_score gap required to override a diversification cap
thresholds.sd_basis: PENDING P6 — measured SE of source_score

thresholds.name: max_single_fund_pct
thresholds.quantity_tested: weight of one fund in the ISA
